comment: A joined fighter walks unarmed into A Frame's anchors under Licence to Kill, falls, and watches living teammates. With eight bots the sides are level, so a joiner at 0:0 attacks; a route for each side was checked with a straight-line walker from every spawn. Run with LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MODE=sabotage LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MUTATORS=licence-to-kill LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_MAP=4 LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_BOTS=8 LOCALEXCEPTION_QA_SEED=42.

states.name: sabotage_fallen_join
states.note: Join; the next round may be needed if muster has passed.

states.name: sabotage_fallen_watch
states.note: Fallen in the open: the view follows a living teammate, and the pips show who is left.
